## Phase 48: Frontend Integration Readiness

### Goal

Prepare backend for React.

### Implement

Confirm frontend needs:

```txt
auth token handling
chat sidebar data
message list pagination
model dropdown
loading states
AI status
error messages
```

### API Endpoints Reviewed

```txt
/api/auth/*
/api/conversations/*
/api/models
/api/models/status
```

### Test

Mock frontend calls using Postman or simple React page.

### Expected Result

Frontend can build:

```txt
login page
signup page
chat sidebar
chat window
model selector
```

### Move to Next Phase When

Backend contract is stable for React.
